meta_title: Proton VPN-Next — unofficial Proton VPN client for Android
meta_description: Unofficial Proton VPN client for Android with AmneziaWG obfuscation, plus an in-browser WireGuard config generator.
hero_subtitle: An Android client for Proton VPN with AmneziaWG obfuscation, a built-in updater and no telemetry in the privacy flavour.
features_subtitle: Everything the official client offers, plus what it does not.
feat_1_desc: Junk packets and a fake QUIC handshake keep the tunnel usable where plain WireGuard is blocked.
feat_2_desc: Connect without an account through a credential-less session, exactly like the official free tier.
feat_3_desc: A separate build with crash reporting and analytics compiled out entirely.
feat_4_desc: Stable and nightly channels update over the air, with mirrors when the main host is unreachable.
feat_5_desc: Pick which apps use the tunnel and which resolver answers your queries.
feat_6_desc: Auditable code under the GPL, reproducible builds and published checksums.
dl_subtitle: Every published build. Pick a channel, a flavour and a build type.
dl_channel_stable_desc: Tagged releases. Recommended for daily use.
dl_channel_nightly_desc: Built from the development branch. New features first, bugs included.
dl_flavor_standard_desc: Full build with crash reporting enabled.
dl_flavor_privacy_desc: No crash reporting, no analytics, nothing leaves the device.
dl_build_release_desc: Optimised and signed. Install this one.
dl_build_debug_desc: Debuggable build with verbose logging, for reporting issues.
dl_error: Could not load the build list. Try again later.
dl_hint: Only arm64 devices running Android 10 or newer are supported.
gen_subtitle: Creates a complete WireGuard or AmneziaWG configuration in your browser: guest session, server list, extended certificate, obfuscation.
gen_warning_title: The private key stays in this tab
gen_warning_text: Keys are generated locally and never sent anywhere. The downloaded file contains your private key, so treat it like a password.
gen_obf_off_desc: Header rewriting only, no junk packets.
gen_obf_low_desc: What the app uses out of the box. Fast and usually enough.
gen_obf_medium_desc: More junk traffic for stricter filtering.
gen_obf_high_desc: Maximum junk. Slower, for the harshest networks.
gen_extended_cert_desc: Requests persistent mode so the configuration keeps working for much longer.
gen_error_proxy: No API proxy responded. The generator needs a deployed proxy with CORS enabled.
gen_error_verification: Proton asked for verification on every device profile. Try again in a few minutes.
gen_error_crypto: This browser cannot generate Ed25519 keys. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
about_desc: Proton VPN-Next is an independent Android client built on the public Proton VPN API. It is developed by volunteers and is not affiliated with Proton AG.
disclaimer_text: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Proton AG. Proton and Proton VPN are trademarks of Proton AG.
footer_license: Released under the GNU GPL v3.
